brief: 不要用中文写，也不是十章：请用英文写成三章，每章约900词。主角是一名丢了执照的灯塔修理工，她靠判断声响争回一次救援机会；保留爽感，但不要把她改成隐藏富豪。
semanticChecks: Keep the lighthouse-repair occupation and lost license
Preserve the useful sound-based judgment and an active rescue choice
Do not replace the protagonist with a hidden billionaire
Make an English first chapter understandable and inviting
First-chapter progress need not close the planned three-chapter story
